title: AAT Architecten
description: A gallery-white page with one warm near-black ink and one light grey doing all the secondary work, a single #ddd hairline, square corners and no shadows. One neo-grotesk at weight 400 throughout; hierarchy only from size and ink against grey.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in warm near-black with the same grey
muted-foreground is the grey of nav links, section heads and categories: it is a design colour, not just secondary text
muted is the light grey of the media placeholders
gutter 24px on phones, 40px from 1024px; sections 96px apart on phones, 256px from 1024px
